findings.passage: “I think it is proper for the Legislature to choose the time, date, manner of elections,” said Republican Rep. Ethan Manning of Logansport. “While I understand there are emergencies, I still think it’s important for the Legislature to be the primary driver of those policies.”
findings.note: Quoted by the Indianapolis Business Journal (article date is the page's publish date) in a House committee hearing on a 2021 voting bill (the same article covers an ID-number-on-mail-ballot-application provision). He was speaking about whether the state election commission or the Legislature should set election dates and rules. He does not speak to ID or citizenship in the quoted words.
